name: MithrilUI Ident
$comment: Identification skin. Every asset this skin controls is drawn in its own
unique colour, and a legend is written next to the skin.
Use it when something looks wrong and its name gives no clue which asset
is responsible, which is most of them: most ArtAssetIDs say nothing about
where they appear. The debug profile answers 'which rule did that'; this
one answers 'which exact asset is that'.
2. pick 'MithrilUI Ident' in game, screenshot the element in question
Anything that keeps its original look is drawn by the client and cannot
be reached from a skin at all.
